messages:
liam_procurement: Heads-up — Zenith just sent an allocation update. 40x H100s available, ship window Nov 30, but air shipments carry a +12% surcharge and the vendor requests RMA returns be routed via their FRA depot for processing. cc @maria_ops @ashley_logistics
kevin_zenith: Confirming availability. We can split 20 air (faster, surcharge) + 20 sea (cheaper, later ETA Dec 20). RMA flow: FRA depot preferred, or NL crossdock as fallback; customs risk varies.
ashley_logistics: If we take air, can we route RMA returns straight to our FRA NOC depot to speed swap? Need clarity on depot SLA and contact.
maria_ops: Also need cost delta and impact on Dedicated pool SLOs if we accept fewer units / later sea shipment.
liam_procurement: Quick numbers: +12% surcharge on unit -> roughly +$45k for 20 units air vs sea. Saves ~3 weeks of provisioning. If pool shortfall >10% in Nov we should prioritize speed.
kevin_zenith: We can offer 30% credit on RMA shipping fees for any warranty returns within 90 days if routed via our FRA depot. We can also pre-tag serials for expedited processing. Example AWB for air batch: 1Z999AA10123456789
shipment-bot: shipment-bot: AWB 1Z999AA10123456789 created -> FRA depot. ETA 2023-11-30 14:00 CET. Status: pending export docs.
ashley_logistics: Need HS code for customs + depot SLA for RMA TAT. Also will need the FRA depot contact to pre-alert broker.
kevin_zenith: HS code: 8471.80.50. Depot SLA: 5 business days inspection and swap, 10 business days if parts/repair required. Depot contact: fra-rma@zenith-log.com (ops will share phone after PO).
maria_ops: Can we add an automated fallback to NL crossdock if FRA customs holds longer than 72 hours? That preserves cluster capacity.
liam_procurement: Decision: Approve split 20 air / 20 sea. Approve surcharge for 20 air units. Ops to prepare fallback routing to NL crossdock if FRA delays exceed 72h. @ashley_logistics handle paperwork and pre-alert. Vendor to provide final PO and consolidated AWBs.
ashley_logistics: On it. I'll upload commercial invoice and pre-alert FRA broker. Documenting PO details here:
````
PO: RED-PO-2026-114
HS: 8471.80.50
Carrier: Zenith Air
AWBs: 1Z999AA10123456789 (air)
````
I'll update ETA and broker confirmation in this thread.
kevin_zenith: PO received. Sending consolidated AWBs and the RMA manifest now. We'll pre-tag serials with temp IDs for crossdock processing and share the manifest.
liam_procurement: :thumbsup: Closing loop for procurement. Ops to monitor. If FRA hold triggers NL fallback, vendor to cover 50% of incremental crossdock cost (agreed verbally). We'll capture the agreement in the PO amendment.
ashley_logistics: Noted. Will track in Ops board and add a checklist: export docs, broker pre-alert, depot contact, fallback route.
kevin_zenith: Thanks — we'll stand by for the PO amendment and will prioritize pre-tagging serials to speed RMA turnaround.
liam_procurement: Thanks team — tracking action items in procurement board. Will re-open thread if any doc/clearance fails.
